name: Plug Power Inc.
summary: Plug Power Inc. designs, develops, and sells hydrogen products and solutions in Europe, Australia, North America, and internationally. The company offers GenDrive, a hydrogen fueled PEM fuel cell system, which powers material handling EVs, including Class 1, 2, 3 and 6 electric forklifts, automated guided vehicles, and ground support equipment; GenFuel, a liquid hydrogen fueling, delivery, generation, storage, and dispensing system; and GenCare, an Internet of Things based maintenance and on-site service program.
